pages.summary: CREAIVA is an AI specialist and digital advertising company headquartered in Dubai. We blend generative AI, cinematic craft, and data-driven media to help brands launch faster, look bolder, and perform harder across every screen.

faqs.question: How quickly can you start?
faqs.answer: Most projects kick off within a week of a signed brief. For urgent launches, we can often start sooner — just tell us the deadline and we'll be honest about what's achievable.

faqs.question: Do you work with international clients?
faqs.answer: Yes. We're headquartered in Dubai but work with brands across the GCC, Europe, and beyond. We reply within 24 hours in any timezone, in English or Arabic.

faqs.question: Can I hire you for just one service?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Every service stands on its own — pick a single discipline, or bundle several into one of our packaged Solutions. There's no minimum retainer to work with us.

faqs.question: How do you price projects?
faqs.answer: Fixed-scope, fixed-price for defined projects — no surprise change orders. Ongoing work (social, ads, SEO) runs on a flat monthly retainer. We share a clear quote after a short discovery call.

faqs.question: Do we own everything you create?
faqs.answer: Yes, always. Source files, brand assets, code, and full usage rights are yours in perpetuity the moment a project is paid in full.

faqs.question: Do you work from our CAD files?
faqs.answer: Yes — we work from STEP, IGES, SolidWorks, and other standard CAD formats. If you don't have CAD, we model from photographs and drawings.

faqs.question: What resolution do you deliver at?
faqs.answer: Stills up to 8K, video masters at 4K, and cutdowns for every needed platform aspect ratio.

faqs.question: Can you deliver AR-ready 3D too?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every model is built with a real-time-friendly topology, so we can export USDZ, GLB, and web AR versions alongside the render.

faqs.question: How much does 3D cost vs. a photo shoot?
faqs.answer: For a single hero shot, photography is cheaper. For 10+ angles, product variants, or shots that don't physically exist yet, 3D is typically cheaper — and always more flexible.
